params.name: pictureSource
params.description: The picture to add: a 4D picture (Picture), a pathname to a picture file on disk in system syntax (Text), or a 4D.File object representing a picture file (4D.File). Omit entirely to add an empty image placeholder.

overloads.semanticRole: Anchors the given picture (or an empty placeholder image if omitted) at a fixed location in wpDoc and returns its reference object.

discriminatedBy.rule: The runtime type of the second argument selects its meaning: a Picture value is used directly as the image; a Text value is treated as a pathname (full, structure-file-relative, or a bare filename located next to the structure file, with extension required); a 4D.File value is treated as a picture-file reference. Passing nothing at all adds an empty image awaiting a wk image expression via WP SET ATTRIBUTES.

constraints: If the picture-source parameter is omitted entirely, a valid picture reference is still returned and an empty image is added; this lets you subsequently call WP SET ATTRIBUTES with the wk image expression selector to fill it with a computed 4D expression.
The returned reference object can be passed to WP SET ATTRIBUTES to reposition/resize/restyle the picture anywhere in wpDoc (page, section, header, footer, layer, etc.).
